name: Thrifty Scrollcrafter
body:
You have learned how to craft scrolls out of cheaper materials.

Prerequisite: Scribe Scroll.

Benefit: You may use cheaper materials to craft your scrolls, reducing the price accordingly.

Normal: It costs 12.5 gp per level of the spell multiplied by the caster’s level in order to create a scroll.
